product.positioning: Traceable procurement preparation and trade material review, with separate approved synthetic registration
product.ownership: User confirmed project ownership and release; detailed personal and AI contributions remain module-specific
workflow: Supplied text, VTT or OCR result to source-linked field candidates
Human review and reasons for corrected or supplied values
Procurement: create unapproved draft; trade: export discrepancies and review questions
Procurement: preview, approve current version, explicitly execute
Persisted effect and independent fresh API verification

mechanisms.materialSources: Raw values, references and review decisions persist separately; missing/conflicting candidates require human decisions
mechanisms.approval: Reviewing material fields does not authorize execution; changed plan versions clear previous approval
mechanisms.execution: Version/hash/target/adapter/expiry checks, persistent compare-and-swap claim and conditional unique-key write
mechanisms.unknownRecovery: Query original request only; retain applied effect; never treat missing response as permission to resubmit
mechanisms.consumerProviderBoundary: Actual supplied VTT parsing and strict OCR-result consumption are implemented; actual OCR/ASR inference providers are not integrated
mechanisms.auditDesign: Per-node receipts and actor-snapshot SHA-256 chains are proposed in the generic parser PRD, not implemented in OfficeFlow
mechanisms.hashBoundary: Content checksums are not signatures, identity authentication, permission grants or OCR accuracy proofs
